approved: Treasury Laws Amendment (2023 Measures No. 2) Bill 2023
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
The bill would increase several income thresholds for the Medicare levy and Medicare levy surcharge.
The increases would match movements in the consumer price index.
The changes would apply from the 2022-23 income year onwards.
Raise the low-income thresholds for the Medicare levy for individuals and families.
Raise the low-income thresholds for the Medicare levy for individuals and families eligible for SAPTO.
Raise the low-income threshold for the Medicare levy surcharge.
Taxpayers liable for the Medicare levy or Medicare levy surcharge.
Treasury Laws Amendment (2023 Measures No. 2) Act 2023
